archReview.notes: VP9 idct_idct 8x8 add RVV (libavcodec/riscv/vp9itxfm_rvv.S): DC-only path (eob==1) via scalar t + vector splat accumulate; full path: pass 1 loads the 8x8 block as ROW vectors (vle16, stride 16 bytes) so the lane-wise butterfly implements the C COLUMN transform (IN(x)=block[x*8+i] spread across vectors at lane i), results stored column-wise (vsse16 stride 16) into a stack tmp[] reproducing the C row-major intermediate; block zeroed (caller contract). Pass 2 reloads as row vectors, same butterfly, then (out+(1<<(bits-1)))>>bits with bits=5 accumulated into dst rows with clip [0,255]. e32 arithmetic with (x+8192)>>14 rounding via vadd.vx+vsra.vi; vnsrl.wi truncation to int16 matches dctcoef semantics; vwcxt/vzext run in source-width mode. Sim: 20 cases x 3 eob (1/5/64) = 0/7680 byte-exact vs C. arch-scan 0.
